extraction: ASCII digit sequences with dotted components, exact text identity; no Chinese number conversion, date arithmetic, unit conversion or semantic inference
reject_disjoint: Keep when query has no numbers, document has no numbers, or their numeric atom sets intersect
require_all: Keep iff every query numeric atom occurs in snapshot title plus full text
selection: On development only, maximize no-answer retrieval abstention subject to no reduction in macro Recall@5 or any answerable case recall; tie choose candidate order
application: Post-filter actual lexical top-5, no rerank or refill, no production behavior change
freeze: Independent holdout and this protocol fixed before first v4 evaluation; no use of v3 holdout for tuning
deployment_bar: No deployment claim from synthetic evaluation; expose individual losses and keep baseline unless reliable evidence warrants separate review
